name: AI D4 - ATS job feeds
description: Public ATS JSON feeds for accounts with a detected ATS, normalised into account_intel.jobs.

parameters.content:
## D4 - ATS job feeds
Accounts with an ATS token from D3 → public JSON feed per provider (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters) → one row shape → account_intel.jobs_raw → intel_apply_jobs. Teamtailor, Personio, BambooHR, Workday have no simple public JSON feed and are skipped; D4b (LinkedIn jobs) covers them.
